start: Every minute; the desk made a fee request two minutes ago for a member who has the app

steps.action: Read open 'fee' requests of the last 15 minutes (at most 100) from the Cloudflare database
user_sees: The request is in the list
must_not: Requests of shop orders or paid requests handed as fee notes

steps.action: Hand id, gym, list id and plan label to the gym server
user_sees: One note per app member: 'Your gym asked you to pay for <plan>. Tap to pay in the app.'
must_not: A name, phone number or amount leaving the Cloudflare database

steps.action: The phone pop-ups run in the same minute
must_not: The note sent twice

start: Bad rows or a server not ready

steps.action: A row with a bad id, a non-uuid gym or no list id
user_sees: That row skipped, the rest handed
must_not: The whole run failing for one bad row

user_sees: One warning 'the gym server has no hq_fee_request_notes yet'
must_not: A warning every minute
The phone pop-ups after it skipped

start: The same request on the next runs

steps.action: The next minute reads the same open request
user_sees: No new note (the server tag makes one note per request)
must_not: A second pop-up for the same request

steps.action: The desk marks it paid before the next run
must_not: A please-pay note after the fee was paid

start: A fee request for a member

user_sees: Only the plan label, never the amount; 'Your gym asked you to pay your fee. Tap to pay in the app.' when there is no label
must_not: An amount or another member's name in the note
The note going to an app member of another gym

start: Admin app, a member with dues who has the MettleUp app

steps.action: Send the desk's 'please pay' fee request for the member's plan
user_sees: The request shows as open on the desk
must_not: The request made for the wrong member

user_sees: The member gets the pop-up on the phone
must_not: The member never told, with the desk unaware

start: Admin app, a member on the list who never joined the app

user_sees: The request is made; no phone note can go
must_not: The desk told the member was notified when no app phone is linked

start: Admin app, an open fee request

steps.action: Mark it paid or cancel it before the next minute
must_not: A please-pay pop-up after the money was taken

steps.action: Cancel it after the note went
user_sees: The note already sent stays on the phone
must_not: A second note for the same request

start: Phone with the MettleUp app joined to the gym; the desk asked for the fee

user_sees: 'Your gym asked you to pay for <plan>. Tap to pay in the app.'
must_not: An amount on the lock screen

user_sees: The pay screen of the app opens
must_not: The app opening on the home screen with no way to pay

start: A member whose list entry is not linked to the app, or who left the gym

steps.action: The desk asks for the fee
must_not: A pop-up from a gym the member left

start: The member paid after the pop-up

steps.action: Open the app the next minute
user_sees: No new pop-up for the same request
must_not: The same request popping up again

start: The phone is locked on a table

steps.action: The pop-up shows on the lock screen
user_sees: Only the gym asking and the plan name
must_not: The amount owed shown to anyone holding the phone
